field.label: Name
field.help: For example: Daily report, Weekly summary for the family.

field.label: Days of the week
field.help: Pick one or more days, for example Sunday only for a weekly summary.

field.label: Time
field.help: 24-hour clock, firewall time zone. If the firewall is off at that moment the report is sent when it comes back, up to 12 hours later.

field.label: Period covered
field.help: By default each report covers the time since the previous one, so nothing is counted twice or missed.

field.label: Language
field.help: The language this report is written in, whatever the GUI is set to. Choose System language to follow the GUI instead. Changing the alert language on the Settings tab does not change this one.

field.label: Sections
field.help: Choose which parts appear in the report.

field.label: Rows per list
field.help: How many entries the top lists show (devices, domains, alerts).

field.label: Compare with previous period
field.help: Show how usage, DNS queries and alerts changed against the period before.

field.label: Recipients
field.help: Leave empty to use the default recipients from the settings tab.

field.label: Only when something needs attention
field.help: Skip the mail when there are no warnings, such as an outage, a new device, a severe alert or a threshold crossed.

field.label: Attach as file
field.help: Also attach the report as an HTML file, handy for keeping or forwarding.
